title: What did you do last weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: Yerlan! You look very relaxed for a Monday. What did you do last weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: It was great! I cooked dinner for my friends on Saturday evening. Rice with chicken!

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: You cooked? I didn't know you could cook!

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: I learned from my grandmother. I practised it a lot last summer in Semey.

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: Nice! Did you go anywhere on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: Yes! We walked to the city park in the afternoon. We stayed there for two hours.

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: Sounds fun. And in the evening — you cooked, and then what?

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: We watched a Kazakh comedy film. Saule laughed so hard she spilled her tea!

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: Ha! What about Sunday? Did you relax again?

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: No — I studied all day Sunday. I worked on my Economics essay for six hours.

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: Six hours! Did you finish it?

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: I finished two sections. I wanted to finish everything, but I stopped at midnight.

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: I studied all weekend too — I never left my room. I only visited the cafeteria for meals.

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: Bekzhan! You need a break sometimes. Did you enjoy anything at all?

dialogue.speaker: Bekzhan
dialogue.text: I called my parents on Sunday evening. We talked for a long time. That was nice.

dialogue.speaker: Yerlan
dialogue.text: See? Next weekend — come with us to the park. I'll cook again!
